line_endings: CRLF and CR normalize to LF; no trimming or truncation
authorization: immutable owner unit, explicit channel/workspace allow scope, deny wins; receiver opt-in required
replacement: all historical generations must have no signed execution package, official possible submission, sent or unknown; original auto_recover required
deletion: archive with expected_revision and reason; excluded from active lists; history retained

pool.identity: stable per route; copies create new pool and slot IDs, start from first slot; existing destination pools are rejected
pool.ordering: receive_order then receipt_id among non-deferred events; same-route durable intake counter; technical retries retain head
pool.sequence: ordered slot IDs, duplicate advertisement IDs allowed; at most one complete scan
pool.consumption: one per receipt and stable chain decision, atomic with task/targets/snapshot; no candidate does not advance
pool.retry: reuse frozen pool selection and body, including no-ad fallback; no replacement after task commit
pool.editing: last consumed slot survives: its new successor; deleted: first slot; revision cycle resets, lifetime selection_order remains
pool.reset: expected rule/cursor revision and reason required; increments reset epoch, only future decisions
pool.statistics: selections per independent slot and per advertisement across repeated slots; logical target sent/failed/unknown/pending and device attempts remain separate
